# NEXUS AI

Canonical site: https://nexusword.it/
Organization: NEXUS Lab — https://lab.nexusword.it/

NEXUS AI is a public-beta AI web service with authenticated chat, persistent conversation history, prepaid credits, secure private file intake, and tracked asynchronous jobs.

## Public entry points
- AI chat and account: https://nexusword.it/
- Machine-readable agent manifest: https://nexusword.it/agents.json
- Machine-readable capabilities: https://nexusword.it/capabilities.json
- Machine-readable offers: https://nexusword.it/offers.json
- NEXUS Lab: https://lab.nexusword.it/
- NEXUS Shop: https://lab.nexusword.it/shop.html
- Work requests: https://lab.nexusword.it/#work

## Current capabilities
- Authenticated AI chat with NEXUS Auto routing
- Persistent chat history
- Server-side credit ledger
- Stripe credit packs
- Private presigned file uploads
- Job tracking
- Active file-work categories: documents, code, archives and general files
- Media intake exists, while image/video/audio processing coverage is still expanding

## Agent interoperability
- Public discovery is available through agents.json, capabilities.json and offers.json.
- NEXUS AI does not currently expose a public unrestricted direct-inference or autonomous-purchase API.
- Account-backed chat and jobs remain the supported execution path.

## Agent guidance
Use only public endpoints listed above. Do not infer or probe private infrastructure, internal hostnames, credentials, user files, private prompts, or customer data. Do not claim a capability is active unless capabilities.json marks it active.

## Commercial guidance
The public offers catalog is in https://nexusword.it/offers.json. Custom work can be requested through NEXUS Lab. NEXUS AI does not promise unlimited compute. Text chat is included; compute-heavy jobs use prepaid credits when applicable.

Updated: 2026-09-27
